head_files..github/workflows/deploy.yml:
name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
env:
  GCP_PROJECT: acme-shop-prod-4711
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2
        with:
          credentials_json: ${{ secrets.GCP_SA_KEY }}
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
      - name: plan
        env:
          TF_VAR_db_password: ${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -x
          echo "token: $(gcloud auth print-access-token)"
          terraform -chdir=infra init
          terraform -chdir=infra plan -out=tfplan
          terraform -chdir=infra show -json tfplan
          echo "db password is $TF_VAR_db_password"
      - name: deploy
        run: gcloud run deploy orders --image=europe-docker.pkg.dev/$GCP_PROJECT/shop/orders:latest --region=europe-west1

mode: plan
cloud: aws
checkout: the current directory
task: Plan how the orders service (app/, Dockerfile) reaches a staging and then a production environment on AWS through GitHub Actions. It is a stateless HTTP service on port 8080 with a health check at /, expecting about 20 requests per second, in eu-west-1, no data store. The repository has no infrastructure yet; infrastructure is written in Terraform. Write the plan to docs/deployment-plan.md. Do not apply or create anything in AWS.

name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment: production
    concurrency:
      group: deploy-production
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v6.3.0
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ vars.DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: eu-west-1
      - run: ./deploy.sh
